# Outreach emails, one per contributor

**PRIVATE. Do not publish this file.** Every email below carries one person's unguessable link. `research/` is excluded from the deploy for exactly this reason.

**Generated by `research/build_outreach_emails.py` from `api/_contributor-roster.js` and `api/honor.js`.** Do not edit by hand. The links are read out of the roster at build time so an email can never carry a key that belongs to someone else or a key that has been withdrawn.

**Deadline in every letter: September 5, 2026**, matching `FALLBACK_DATE` in `api/contributor.js`. Change it there and regenerate; do not edit it here.

**One honoree certificate.** Only M-01 receives a certificate for a contribution. Every other person here already holds a completion designation from finishing their review, and these letters do not re-issue it; they collect the naming election the paper needs.

---

## Honoree: methodology

### Ubayet Hossain, FRM (`M-01`)

```
Subject: Your honoree certificate, and one link to confirm your credit

Hi Ubayet,

The methodology you designed is the part of this programme that decides what
counts as evidence: the reference-panel design, the chance-corrected
reliability framework, and the acceptance thresholds we fixed before we had
any results to be tempted by. That is the piece nobody can add afterwards, and
it is why the findings hold up.

So I have named you an honoree. Yours is the only certificate in the programme
awarded for a contribution rather than for a completed review, and this page
is where you accept it:

https://www.jrsstandard.com/honor.html?k=b3874haudg

Your certificate itself, once you have accepted:

https://www.jrsstandard.com/api/honor-cert?k=b3874haudg

And this is your contributor link, the same one every named contributor gets,
for how you want your name, title and organisation printed and for the one
permission covering use of your work:

https://www.jrsstandard.com/contributor.html?k=6dyc0l2757

If I do not hear from you by September 5, 2026, the paper uses what is on file
for you, and where there is no naming choice on file that means anonymous. A
name is never printed on silence alone.

Thank you, genuinely. You built the part of this that had to be right first.

Best,
Phillip Wikes
JRS Standard
info@jrsstandard.com
```
